name: testy
description: Automatic affected C# tests and live, retained code coverage for .NET 10+ and Microsoft.Testing.Platform.

commands.title: Refresh and Run All C# Tests

testy.autoRun.description: Automatically establish a baseline on open and run affected tests after changes.

testy.runMode.description: Choose affected test files or the entire C# suite.
enumDescriptions: Use recorded code usage, with project fallback when information is incomplete.
Run every C# test file after a change.

testy.trigger.description: Choose which changes trigger automatic tests.
enumDescriptions: Editor saves, plus files renamed or deleted through VS Code.
All matching disk changes, including external edits and branch switches.

testy.debounceTime.description: Milliseconds to wait after the latest change before rebuilding and testing.

testy.runWithCoverage.description: Collect and retain code coverage. Disabling coverage uses conservative project selection.

testy.showCoverage.description: Show covered, uncovered, and stale coverage markers in editor gutters.

testy.fileWatcherPattern.description: Files whose changes can trigger tests.

testy.exclude.description: Additional glob patterns to ignore. Generated files, bin, obj, TestResults, node_modules, and .git are always excluded.

testy.buildConfiguration.description: MSBuild configuration used for builds and test discovery.

testy.testArguments.description: Additional MTP application arguments. Discovery, filtering, and connection arguments are managed by Testy.

testy.timeoutSeconds.description: Maximum duration for an individual build, discovery, or test-file run.

testy.coverageToolPath.description: Optional path to dotnet-coverage. By default, Testy installs a pinned collector into its own storage on first use.

scripts.compile: tsc -p ./ && npm run build:analyzer && npm run build:process-host
scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Testy builds and executes workspace code automatically.

virtualWorkspaces.description: Testy requires the .NET CLI and local workspace files.
